node.title: Re: Debugging DESTROY calls in forking application
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Print statements? Setting hundreds of debug points? Is there any good way to overload DESTROY without loosing the original functions?

You could do this with e.g. [mod://Class::Method::Modifiers], or see:

  • [id://1187528] and [stevieb]'s followup [id://1195143|here]
  • [id://1195131]
